claim: The SCORE routine takes D = A:B, A an exponent (0-7) and B a BCD mantissa (0-99), and awards B x 10^A.
Killing a Lander (LKILL) awards KILP 0115 = 15 x 10^1 = 150 points.
Killing a Mutant (SCZKIL, the schizoid) awards KILP 0115 = 15 x 10^1 = 150 points.
Killing a Baiter (UFOKIL) awards KILP 0120 = 20 x 10^1 = 200 points.
Killing a Bomber (TIEKIL) awards KILO 0125 = 25 x 10^1 = 250 points.
Killing a Pod (PRBKIL, the probe) awards KILO 0210 = 10 x 10^2 = 1000 points.
Killing a Swarmer loads LDD #$0115 = 15 x 10^1 = 150 points before JSR SCORE.
Shooting a bomb/mine (BKIL) loads LDD #$25 = 25 x 10^0 = 25 points.
The P250 pop-up (an uncaught humanoid landing safely) loads LDD #$0125 = 25 x 10^1 = 250 points.
An uncaught, released humanoid that free-falls and lands safely spawns the P250 (250-point) process (LDX #P250 at ALAND).
The P500 pop-up (the humanoid catch/rescue) loads LDD #$0150 = 50 x 10^1 = 500 points.
The player catching a falling humanoid spawns the P500 (500-point) process (NEWP P500,STYPE, the AKIL1 player-collision path) - so catching pays 500, not 250.
A caught humanoid carried down and deposited on the ground spawns the P500 (500-point) process (LDX #P500 at ALAND0).
The wave-complete bonus multiplier is the wave number (PWAV), loaded before the cap and shift.
The bonus multiplier is clamped: CMPB #5 (with the following LDB #5) caps it at 5, so min(wave,5).
The factory default REPLAY (extra man) level is $01,$00 = one extra man every 10,000 points.
The factory default number of ships (men) is NSHIP = $03 = 3.
A pop-up/score process runs as STYPE = 0, the SYSTEM PROCESS type.
SCRX loads REPLA (replays available) to test the score against the next extra-man threshold.
